en.title: How to change a folder icon on Mac
en.description: Use your own image in Finder, or choose a built-in color icon in Moodsk. See the result before you start.

en.title: Give your Mac project folders a color system
en.description: Use four repeatable colors for project folders. Apply free Moodsk color icons and keep folder names clear.

zh-hans.title: 给 Mac 项目文件夹定一套颜色，用起来更好认
zh-hans.description: 用四种固定颜色给文件夹做标记，并通过 Moodsk 的免费颜色图标完成实际更换。

en.title: Make a folder icon with your own text
en.description: Edit a folder icon label in Moodsk, preview the design, and understand which output actions require Editor Pro.

zh-hans.title: 给文件夹图标加上自己的文字
zh-hans.description: 在 Moodsk 中编辑图标文字，检查小尺寸效果，并了解编辑器导出与应用的付费范围。
